# Event catalogue

<!-- Generated by `python manage.py event_catalogue --write` from each module's events.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every event a module publishes through the outbox, with its payload contract. Rules
(D-041, `backend/platform_core/events.py`): names are `<thing>.<past-tense verb>`;
adding an optional field is compatible; any other change is a new version declared
next to the old one; payloads carry IDs and codes, never personal data; consumers
tolerate duplicates and out-of-order delivery.

Every event also carries: event ID, type, version, aggregate (type, ID, version),
organization (public UUID, the visibility scope), occurred-at time and correlation ID.

## Published by `organizations`

| Event | Version | Payload | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `invitation.accepted` | 1 | `invitation_id`, `organization_id`, `membership_id`, `user_id`, `role` | An invitation was accepted: the person is now an active member with that role. |
| `invitation.created` | 1 | `invitation_id`, `organization_id`, `role`, optional `invited_by` | Someone was invited to join an organization with a role. |
| `invitation.revoked` | 1 | `invitation_id`, `organization_id` | A pending invitation was withdrawn (also when a newer one replaces it). |
| `membership.granted` | 1 | `membership_id`, `organization_id`, `user_id`, `role` | A person was made an active member directly (operator or demo set-up), not by invitation. |
| `membership.status_changed` | 1 | `membership_id`, `organization_id`, `user_id`, `status`, `previous_status` | A membership was suspended, revoked or reactivated (by an operator or a re-invitation). |
| `organization.status_changed` | 1 | `organization_id`, `status`, `previous_status` | An organization was verified, suspended or reinstated (pending, active, suspended). |
